blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Mamamayang Liberal party-list Rep. Leila de Lima on Wednesday hailed the ruling of the Supreme Court (SC) restricting unprogrammed funding as a major victory for fiscal transparency. However, de Lima voiced regret that the tribunal stopped short of striking down standby funds altogether. On Tuesday, the SC ruled that key provisions 2024, 2025 and 2026 national budgets breached constitutional spending limits when lawmakers unilaterally inflated the executive’s request for unprogrammed funds. De Lima, a co-petitioner in one of the cases partially granted by the high court, thanked the SC for “setting clear constitutional limits” on the funding that […]...
